errors.english: contradicting the essential nature of phenomena
errors.why: chos here is the logical property/predicate (dharma) of the thesis: the thesis-fault is negation of the predicate's own nature (here 'made by another'), not 'nature of phenomena/reality'.

note: Accurate rendering of the argument against suffering being made by another; only the logical sense of chos is lost.
Faithful translation of the Daśabhūmika citation and the discussion of ignorance and the view associated with it.

errors.why: rko long gsol ba means to raise an objection or remonstrate (the ministers objecting 'one should not give to him'), not to request out of jealousy.

note: Word-by-word gloss commentary is rendered faithfully apart from the remonstrance idiom.

errors.english: Taking heart from what his dear friend had shown him, the elder brother, possessing keen intellect,
errors.why: dang por skyes pa renders agrajanman, 'brahmin' (as with Kapila agrajanman in the next stanza): the brahmin friend, having reassured his dear friend, takes the golden image and sets out; there is no elder brother.

fix.find: Taking heart from what his dear friend had shown him, the elder brother, possessing keen intellect,
fix.replace: Having thus reassured his dear friend, the brahmin, possessing keen intellect,

errors.english: born into the great clan of Nyagrodha
errors.why: rtog pa renders Skt. kalpa ('like'): the famed family of one born in the Kāśyapa gotra is 'like a nyagrodha tree', a simile, not a clan named Nyagrodha.

note: Free verse paraphrase that follows the story, but misidentifies the brahmin as an elder brother and turns a simile into a clan name.
Verses and commentary in praise of the Vinaya are rendered faithfully with the verse structure kept.

errors.english: If, even though worldly valid cognition is unerring, it is still something created by a person
errors.why: The subject is worldly statements: 'if worldly [statements], though non-deceptive with respect to valid cognition, are nonetheless made by persons', not 'worldly valid cognition is unerring'.
dam bcas pa here is the fixed stipulation/agreement (samaya) by which a powerful person sets up the mantra as a convention (brda), as the next side explains, not a logical thesis.

note: The Mīmāṃsā debate on authorless Vedas is followed well; two clauses are mis-parsed.

errors.english: These enter the person through the birth canal, and they are boiled and burned
errors.why: The offender enters the blazing iron animals through their genital passage and is cooked in their bellies; the animals do not enter him.

fix.find: These enter the person through the birth canal, and they are boiled and burned
fix.replace: Such persons enter them through their birth canal and are boiled and burned

errors.why: The hell named is Great Lotus (Mahāpadma), not Padma; the note gives the wrong original.

errors.english: a man who forces another man into sexual misconduct
errors.why: The Tibetan speaks of a man engaging in sexual misconduct with a man; coercion is not stated.

note: Generally faithful catalogue of punishments for sexual misconduct, but the hell-scene with the iron animals has its agents reversed.
Faithful rendering of the Vinaya rules on received consent and a monk detained on poṣadha day.

errors.why: nye dbang is Upendra (Viṣṇu), named alongside Indra; 'lesser deities' misrepresents it in the main text.

note: Accurate gloss on the arhat's qualities, knowledges, abhijñās and pratisaṃvids.

errors.english: means at the actual time the act is to be performed, not at any other time
errors.why: The Tibetan says it is to be done at another time, not at that very same time.

fix.find: means at the actual time the act is to be performed, not at any other time
fix.replace: means it is to be done at another time, not at that very same time

errors.why: In this Mūlasarvāstivāda Vinaya commentary the class is saṃghāvaśeṣa; the Pali form is used where the Sanskrit tradition is meant.

errors.english: If one is exhorted by those who agree with him or through non-Dharmic means
errors.why: mthun pa / mi mthun pa are a united vs. divided saṅgha (samagra/vyagra), and the exemptions are combinations (united saṅgha with non-Dharma, etc.), not 'those who agree with him' or alternatives joined by 'or'.

note: Follows the saṃghāvaśeṣa commentary in outline, but reverses the timing gloss and misreads the united/divided saṅgha terms in the exemption list.
